pages.title: A Seagrass Pasture
pages.text: Successfully milk a Sea Cow and collect one item it forages after feeding by Tall Seagrass.

pages.title: A Seagrass Pasture
pages.text: Sea pickles illuminate the underwater pasture and ready food provisions the next visit.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Offer its accepted food, preserve Tall Seagrass and use an empty bucket for milking. Both checks require a real native result.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Milk a Sea Cow with a bucket and provide food before its Tall Seagrass foraging. It supplies milk and can uncover loot through its feeding behavior.
